items.title: 'The party had to end': Young investors torn on budget tax reform
items.description: Some young Australians locked out of the property market due to unaffordable housing have pursued ETFs and "rentvesting" as a way to build financial security. Here's what they make of the budget's CGT reforms.

items.title: Should a nurse pay the same tax rate as their employer? The budget says no
items.description: As the federal budget prompts howls of protest from those who earn the bulk of their income from owning assets rather than working, we shouldn't forget the relative privilege that has allowed many of those people to take those risks.

items.title: Man charged with murder after woman and two children found dead in Sydney home
items.description: A man, 47, has been charged after three people were found dead in a home in Sydney's south-west in what police allege is a domestic violence-related incident.

items.title: 'I wish I were dead': The heartbreaking toll of Australia's favourite pastime
items.description: Australians are the world's biggest gamblers, losing billions every year. But the true cost goes far beyond the financial.

items.title: Five dead in shooting at San Diego mosque, including two suspects
items.description: A shooting at a San Diego mosque has left three men dead as well as two teenage suspects, police say.

items.title: Stranded driver, students among 10 rescues during heavy rainfall in NSW and Qld
items.description: Almost 50 high school students and teachers have been rescued after becoming stranded by floodwater at a national park in the Scenic Rim while on a school camp. Earlier, near the New South Wales and Queensland border, crews worked to rescue a person stuck in a vehicle at Numinbah Valley near Murwillumbah. NSW SES volunteers and emergency service partners have responded to 197 incidents since Monday afternoon.

items.title: Trump says he has postponed a planned new strike on Iran
items.description: US President Donald Trump says an attack on Iran that was "scheduled for tomorrow" has been postponed at the request of Gulf state leaders.

items.title: Live: ASX set to jump on Iran peace hopes
items.description: The futures market tips the ASX 200 to jump more than 1 per cent as a shaky peace holds in the Middle East. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Spotting these AI relationship warning signs may avoid a delusional spiral
items.description: Intensive chatbot use may be amplifying dangerous and harmful delusions for some users. Here are some of the "red flags" for "AI psychosis".

items.title: The parts of Victoria adding the biggest share to disaster damage bills
items.description: At least $57 billion worth of infrastructure in Victoria is vulnerable to more frequent and severe bushfires, floods and extreme heat. This figure is expected to grow.

items.title: Married at First Sight UK off air after rape allegations
items.description: British broadcaster Channel 4 removes all previous seasons of Married at First Sight after rape allegations come to light.

items.title: What Kylie Minogue learned from Michael Hutchence and Nick Cave
items.description: Australia's reigning Queen of Pop discusses her relationships with Nick Cave and the late Michael Hutchence, and being tapped to headline the AFL grand final's pre-game entertainment.

items.title: Live: Labor flags relief for small businesses to adjust to trust tax changes
items.description: The federal government flags relief for small businesses that will need to adjust to trust tax changes announced in last week's budget. Follow live.

items.title: Boomers star Joe Ingles thrilled to come 'home' in coup NBL signing
items.description: The legendary Boomers and NBA star will return to Australia's NBL for the first time since 2009, signing with Melbourne United for two years.

items.title: What you can do today to ease money stress in your relationship
items.description: While financial tension between partners isn't always about money, many people clash over values, spending habits and how they respond to financial pressure.

items.title: Today's quiz tests you on iconic movie quotes. You. Shall. (Probably.) Pass!
items.description: The ABC Timelines quiz is back to test your knowledge of some of the most iconic movie quotes of the 2000s.

items.title: Two German film students track down their stolen movie in new doco
items.description: What do you do when your stolen film wins a slew of awards for the thief? In the case of these filmmakers, you travel across the globe to hunt him down.

items.title: 'Two years to live': Why we used our super for weight loss surgery
items.description: Weight loss surgery has become an increasingly common option for people grappling with obesity — and many are funding it using retirement savings.

items.title: Arsenal edges closer to Premier League title despite more VAR drama
items.description: Kai Havertz emerges Arsenal's hero after scoring the winner against Burnley, and is spared a sending-off for a horror tackle.

items.title: Strong catch numbers end banana prawn season early for major operator
items.description: The largest operator in Australia's most valuable prawn fishery wraps up banana prawn season a month early because catch numbers were so high.

items.title: Flight path granny flat ban lifted in parts of Sydney's west
items.description: The NSW government will permit secondary dwellings such as granny flats in some areas affected by noise from Western Sydney International Airport.

items.title: Elon Musk loses lawsuit against OpenAI and Sam Altman
items.description: The Tesla boss accused OpenAI of wrongfully trying to enrich investors and insiders at the nonprofit's expense, and failing to prioritise AI's safety.

items.title: Historic flour mill walls reduced to rubble after failed heritage bid
items.description: In the face of protests, the remnants of a historic flour mill in Mount Gambier are now a pile of crumbled stone. The site will be developed into a multi-storey hotel complex and townhouses.

items.title: Two men arrested over stunt at Punch the monkey's enclosure
items.description: One of the men was detained by a zookeeper and arrested after allegedly climbing a fence and breaking into the enclosure.

items.title: Tomic edges closer to French Open amid Aussie qualifying nightmare
items.description: Bernard Tomic is just two wins from reaching his first main draw of the French Open since 2019 after being the only Australian to enjoy success in the qualifiers.
